name: likh

name: shabda
which: merge, not rename: shabda prints string content, likha prints string address

name: paadh
which: not a duplicate: pad is 1-arg, paadh is 3-arg fd/buf/count read used by patra

name: pankti_len
which: maap (7 lib length functions use maap, not aayam)

name: kosh_empty
which: rikta spelling: existing rakh_rikta/suchi_rikta use rikta, not rikt

name: kosh_enqueue
which: direction: enqueue appends to BACK, purva means front

name: pehchan
which: bare name: samanvaya module already breaks module-prefix-first for these functions

name: nishan
which: chinha already means sign in roop/upayog contexts; here it would mean trace

name: chay_rikta
which: rikta spelling (see kosh_rikt); inherited from chay_rikta

name: samanvaya_akar_na
which: asti_ for booleans: function returns 1=bad shape, 0=ok, not a shape
